prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. Portrait of a ravishing fluffy blue-eyed ragdoll cat surrounded by softly defocused pale pink tulips on a pale blue background, one tulip in sharp focus by a white paw. Contemporary floral fashion photography, tender direct gaze, extremely beautiful fur and natural window light. Intended final composition 900:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
